page0.text:
If I'm going to die either way, I can't let him escape...!
"Screw you..."
I wrap the chain further around my arm.
Unlike before, I grab onto the chain so that it won't let me go.
"...Don't ever come back into this world again...!"
Without resisting, I throw myself into the black hole.
"Idio—ARE YOU INSANEEEEEE...!!!???"
I roll down.
I fall into an endless darkness while my body is being melted.

page1.text:
The black mud mercilessly eats into my body.
My body is stripped off, and I fall into the deep darkness just as the soul known as Shirou Emiya.
